//: The harness has its own tsconfig because web/tsconfig.json includes only
`src` and `vite.config.ts`, so nothing here would otherwise be type-checked
at all. Every compiler option below is copied from that file rather than
loosened: the harness imports the renderer directly, and a harness held to a
weaker standard than the code it exercises is a harness that can be wrong
`npm run typecheck` does not pick this up — it runs one tsc over the root
config. The gpu-golden CI job runs `tsc -p test/gpu-golden` as its first
step, which is what keeps this from rotting.
`vite.config.ts` and the Node-side `.mjs` files are outside `include`: they
import Node built-ins, `@types/node` is not a dependency of this package, and
adding one to web/package.json is not this harness's call to make. Those files
are checked by running them, which the same CI job does.
